title: Fill column
summary: A column that fills a parent of definite height (the app shell body with contain, a workspace pane): the fixed slot keeps its height and the rest fills what is left and scrolls on its own.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Height of the fixed region as a CSS length (12rem, 40vh); empty keeps its natural height. Not a length: ignored with one warning.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the regions and between fixed children, on the spacing scale (as pk-stack).

slots.name: fixed
slots.description: Content that keeps its height above the rest (a camera preview, a summary). Empty: the region is hidden.
Content that fills the remaining height and scrolls on its own (a list).

parts.name: rest
parts.description: The region that fills the rest and scrolls.

cssProperties.name: --pk-fill-column-gap
cssProperties.description: Overrides the gap prop with any length.

a11y: A plain layout box with no role; the reading order is the fixed region, then the rest. The scrolling region is reachable by keyboard through its focusable content.

examples.title: A preview above a scrolling list
examples.html: <pk-fill-column fixed="8rem"><pk-card slot="fixed" heading="Camera preview">Live preview</pk-card><pk-stack><pk-text>Scanned item 1</pk-text><pk-text>Scanned item 2</pk-text><pk-text>Scanned item 3</pk-text></pk-stack></pk-fill-column>
